title: esenbeckia pumila var. latifolia
intro: Esenbeckia pumila var. latifolia, commonly known as the 'Lantern Flower', is a plant species that belongs to the Rutaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Esenbeckia pumila var. latifolia include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antipyretic agent, helping to reduce inflammation, prevent infection, and bring down fever. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic properties include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenes, which have been shown to possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
